tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The DTECH DP to HDMI Converter DT-6505 is a premium-quality adapter that converts DisplayPort (DP) signal to HDMI for seamless connectivity between modern laptops, desktop PCs, and HDMI-enabled devices such as monitors, projectors, and HDTVs.

It supports Full HD 1080p resolution (1920x1080) and delivers both high-definition video and digital audio with exceptional clarity. With its plug-and-play functionality, users can enjoy stable transmission without the need for extra drivers or software.

The converter features a durable chipset, ensuring stable performance for long-term use. Ideal for corporate presentations, home entertainment setups, gaming, and professional multimedia environments, this adapter ensures smooth signal conversion with zero lag.


Technical Specifications

  • Brand: DTECH
  • Model: DT-6505
  • Input Port: DisplayPort (DP Male)
  • Output Port: HDMI (Female)
  • Supported Resolution: Up to 1920x1080p Full HD
  • Video Bandwidth: 10.8Gbps for stable high-definition transmission
  • Audio Support: Digital audio pass-through
  • Connector Type: Gold-plated for better conductivity and durability
  • Compatibility: Windows, Mac OS, Linux systems with DP interface
  • Applications: PC, Laptop, HDTV, Monitor, Projector
